content: 1. Nevirapine reduces the levels or effects of dronabinol by influencing the metabolism of the hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4. Dronabinol is a substrate of CYP3A4. Use caution and monitor closely. 2. Nicardipine increases the levels or effects of dronabinol by affecting the metabolism of hepatic enzymes CYP2C9/10 and CYP3A4. Dronabinol is a substrate of CYP3A4. Use caution and monitor closely. 3. Co-administration of dronabinol and olopatadine intranasal increases sedation, leading to an elevated risk of central nervous system (CNS) depression, which may impair psychomotor performance and cause daytime impairment. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 4. Oxcarbazepine decreases the levels or effects of dronabinol by influencing the metabolism of the hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4. Dronabinol is a substrate of CYP3A4. Use caution and monitor closely. 5. Pentobarbital reduces the levels or effects of dronabinol by affecting the metabolism of the hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4. Dronabinol is a substrate of CYP3A4. Use caution and monitor closely. 6. Phenobarbital decreases the levels or effects of dronabinol by influencing the metabolism of hepatic enzymes CYP2C9/10 and CYP3A4. Dronabinol is a substrate of CYP3A4. Use caution and monitor closely. 7. Phenytoin reduces the levels or effects of dronabinol by affecting the metabolism of hepatic enzymes CYP2C9/10 and CYP3A4. Additionally, dronabinol increases phenytoin levels due to plasma protein binding competition. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 8. Piroxicam increases the levels or effects of dronabinol by influencing the metabolism of the hepatic enzyme CYP2C9/10. Dronabinol is a substrate of CYP2C9. Use caution and monitor closely. 9. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of dronabinol by affecting the metabolism of the hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4. Dronabinol is a substrate of CYP3A4. Use caution and monitor closely. 10. Primidone decreases the levels or effects of dronabinol by influencing the metabolism of hepatic enzymes CYP2C9/10 and CYP3A4. Dronabinol is a substrate of CYP3A4. Use caution and monitor closely. 11. Ribociclib increases the levels or effects of dronabinol by affecting the metabolism of the hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4. Use caution and monitor closely. 12. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of dronabinol by influencing the metabolism of the hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4. Dronabinol is a substrate of CYP3A4. Use caution and monitor closely. 13. Rifampin decreases the levels or effects of dronabinol by affecting the metabolism of hepatic enzymes CYP2C9/10 and CYP3A4. Dronabinol is a substrate of CYP3A4. Use caution and monitor closely. 14. Rifapentine reduces the levels or effects of dronabinol by influencing the metabolism of hepatic enzymes CYP2C9/10 and CYP3A4. Dronabinol is a substrate of CYP3A4. Use caution and monitor closely. 15. Ritonavir increases the levels or effects of dronabinol by affecting the metabolism of the hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4. Dronabinol is a substrate of CYP3A4. Use caution and monitor closely. 16. Co-administration of dronabinol and ropeginterferon alfa-2b may lead to additive neuropsychiatric side effects, including excessive CNS toxicity. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 17. Rucaparib increases the levels or effects of dronabinol by influencing the metabolism of the hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4. Use caution and monitor closely. 18. Dronabinol increases sirolimus levels due to plasma protein binding competition. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Dronabinol is highly bound to plasma proteins and may displace other highly protein-bound drugs, increasing their free fraction. This has not been confirmed in vivo. Exercise caution with narrow therapeutic index drugs. 19. Sparsentan decreases the levels or effects of dronabinol by affecting the metabolism of the hepatic enzyme CYP2C9/10. Sparsentan, a CYP2C9 inducer, reduces the efficacy of CYP2C9 substrates. Use caution and monitor closely. 20. St. John’s Wort reduces the levels or effects of dronabinol by influencing the metabolism of the hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4. Dronabinol is a substrate of CYP3A4. Use caution and monitor closely. 21. Stiripentol and dronabinol may increase each other’s effects through sedation. Stiripentol is a CYP3A4 inhibitor and inducer, which may require dosage adjustments for co-administered CYP3A4 substrates. Monitor closely. 22. Sulfadiazine increases the levels or effects of dronabinol by affecting the metabolism of the hepatic enzyme CYP2C9/10. Dronabinol is a substrate of CYP2C9. Use caution and monitor closely. 23. Sulfamethoxazole increases the levels or effects of dronabinol by influencing the metabolism of the hepatic enzyme CYP2C9/10. Dronabinol is a substrate of CYP2C9. Use caution and monitor closely. 24. Dronabinol increases tacrolimus levels due to plasma protein binding competition. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Dronabinol is highly bound to plasma proteins and may displace other highly protein-bound drugs, increasing their free fraction. This has not been confirmed in vivo. Exercise caution with narrow therapeutic index drugs. 25. Tazemetostat reduces the levels or effects of dronabinol by affecting the metabolism of the hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4. Use caution and monitor closely. 26. Tecovirimat decreases the levels or effects of dronabinol by influencing the metabolism of the hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4. Tecovirimat is a weak CYP3A4 inducer. Monitor sensitive CYP3A4 substrates for effectiveness if co-administered. 27. Tinidazole increases the toxicity of dronabinol by inhibiting aldehyde dehydrogenase. This combination is contraindicated. Tinidazole contains 5% (w/w) propylene glycol, which can cause disulfiram-like reactions when co-administered with dronabinol. Discontinue tinidazole at least 14 days before starting dronabinol and avoid tinidazole within 7 days of completing dronabinol treatment. 28. Tipranavir increases the levels or effects of dronabinol by affecting the metabolism of the hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4. Dronabinol is a substrate of CYP3A4. Use caution and monitor closely. 29. Tucatinib increases the levels or effects of dronabinol by influencing the metabolism of the hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4. Avoid or use alternative drugs. If unavoidable, reduce the dose of CYP3A4 substrates according to product labeling and monitor closely. 30. Dronabinol increases valproic acid levels due to plasma protein binding competition. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Dronabinol is highly bound to plasma proteins and may displace other highly protein-bound drugs, increasing their free fraction. This has not been confirmed in vivo. Exercise caution with narrow therapeutic index drugs. 31. Voriconazole increases the levels or effects of dronabinol by affecting the metabolism of hepatic enzymes CYP2C9/10 and CYP3A4. Dronabinol is a substrate of CYP3A4. Use caution and monitor closely. 32. Co-administration of dronabinol and zuranolone may lead to pharmacodynamic synergism, increasing CNS depressant effects and impairing psychomotor performance. Avoid or use alternative drugs. If unavoidable, consider dose reduction. 33. Dronabinol may cause dizziness, euphoria, paranoia, somnolence, abnormal thinking, abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, depression, nightmares, speech difficulties, emotional lability, hypotension, tremors, flushing, sweating, anorexia, hepatic enzyme elevation, tinnitus, amnesia, anxiety, hallucinations, ataxia, confusion, depersonalization, asthenia, palpitations, tachycardia, fatigue, and hypersensitivity reactions. Capsules may cause hypersensitivity to sesame seed oil.
